lock.title: This profile is locked
lock.subtitle: Enter the secret to open it.
lock.use_vault: Use the vault master password instead
lock.use_password: Use the app lock password instead
lock.forgot_title: Erase this profile and start over
lock.forgot_warning: The lock does not encrypt your data, so it cannot be removed without erasing what is behind it. This permanently erases the history, favorites, cookies, logins, passwords and settings of this profile from this computer, then opens it empty and unlocked. It cannot be undone.
lock.erasing: Erasing the profile. Spark will open again in a moment.
lock.not_encrypted: The app lock only blocks access to Spark. It does not encrypt the data on this computer.
lock.error_wrong_secret: That is not right. Try again.
lock.error_wrong_secret_wait: That is not right. Wait {seconds} s before trying again.
lock.error_throttled: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.
lock.error_not_enabled: This profile has no app lock.
lock.error_method_unavailable: That way of opening is not turned on for this profile.
lock.error_already_on: The app lock is already on. Use the other options to change it.
lock.error_last_method: At least one way to open Spark must stay on. Turn the app lock off instead.
lock.error_password_invalid: The password must have 8 to 256 characters.
lock.error_vault_without_password: The password vault of this profile has no master password. Create one first, or choose another way.
lock.error_hello_failed: Windows Hello failed. Try again or use another way.
lock.error_hello_unavailable: Windows Hello is not available on this computer.
lock.error_private: The app lock is not available in private windows.
lock.error_start_failed: The profile was unlocked but could not start. The error log has the details.
lock.error_erase_failed: The profile could not be erased. The error log has the details.
lock.error_failed: Something went wrong with the app lock. The error log has the details.
lock.settings_description: Ask for a secret every time this profile opens. It only blocks access to Spark: the data on this computer is not encrypted.
lock.vault_password: Master password of the password vault
lock.hello_only_warning: With only Windows Hello, a Windows PIN reset or a new Windows account would lock you out. Add a password too.
lock.confirm_hello_hint: Windows will ask for your PIN, fingerprint or face.
lock.notice_on: The app lock is on. Spark will ask for the secret the next time this profile opens.
lock.search_description: Ask for a password, Windows Hello or the vault master password every time a profile opens.
